guard/32136.htm.text: Marksman Basil: May you be blessed as you depart on your journey! This is an exciting time, but take care that you do not forget your roots. We will always remember you! When you go below the Cave of Souls , Kamael Village will appear.

links.text: See information on permanent residence and tax rates.
